name: Fillman and Sons Floors and More
description: Emmaus shop for flooring, countertops, paint, wallpaper, window treatments, installation, refinishing, and remodeling, about an hour north of Philadelphia.

hero.headline: Fillman and Sons Floors and More
hero.sub: Barry Fillman and his sons publish this Emmaus shop as the first location, about an hour north of Philadelphia.

items: Flooring, countertops, paint, wallpaper, and window treatments
Installation, refinishing, remodeling, and insurance restoration
Handy man maintenance listed on the official product and service menus
Address listed as 4030 Chestnut Street, Unit 3, Emmaus, PA 18049
Regular hours listed Monday through Friday 10:00am to 4:00pm
Saturday and Sunday are listed as closed

story.heading: About
paragraphs: The official contact page says Barry Fillman and his sons have decades of experience working and living in the area.
Emmaus is described there as just south of Allentown and about an hour north of Philadelphia.

items: The homepage itself does not publish the phone. Use contact_1.html for the verified number.
Products and services are split on the official menus: flooring, countertops, paint, and treatments.
Confirm installer availability and insurance-restoration scope on the official site before a visit.

feature.heading: Call the number on the contact page
feature.text: The leftover demo had no phone. This preview uses only 610-928-1515 from fillmanandsons.com/contact_1.html.

spotlight.heading: Weekday shop hours
spotlight.text: Official hours are Monday through Friday 10:00am to 4:00pm. Saturday and Sunday are closed. Recheck before you drive.
